checked_semantics: Rank counts all lower-order rows in each original partition, then deduplicates only projected rows.
Computed partition is an injective shift, preserving the modeled partition classes.
Finite count frame includes at most three preceding/current positions ordered by unique id.
Grouped controls first form the source groups, then rank their aggregate rows; hidden group columns do not participate in final DISTINCT.
Repeated aliases and selected constants retain output tuple equality.
ORDER BY/LIMIT control compares the result sequence, not just its multiset.
All-null legacy rank behavior is excluded using ANSI mode and nonnullable keys.
limits: Actual SQL translation and RBO reachability require native execution.
Grouped-window failures must be distinguished from pre-existing group-reference and aggregate alias limitations.
Empty inputs can be optimized away and do not alone prove the intended operators execute.
